newsitem.title: USA: Lark sees Q4 revenues close to Q3 levels.
newsitem.headline: Lark sees Q4 revenues close to Q3 levels.

text.p: Lark Technologies Inc said on Friday it expected revenues in the fourth quarter to be close to third quarter revnues of $886,121.

In the third quarter, Lark, which provides contract DNA sequencing and related molecular biology services, said its revenues rose 79 percent from $494,176 in the same period last year, due to large scale, high throughput sequency projects.

But Vincent Kazmer, Lark president and chief executive officer, said because large scale sequencing projects were variable, the company was developing new techniques and services for gene discovery, gene function and DNA sequencing.

"Our new Genetic Stability Testing service supports biotech-derived product development and manufacture," he said. "Additionally, this fall we experienced a 5-fold increase in our quick-turnaround sequencing business. These new services will help to offset the variability of large scale projects."
